Finding a holiday gift that feels thoughtful, useful and a little unexpected can be easier said than done. For husbands, boyfriends or dads, some might love the latest tech while others would rather spend the afternoon solving puzzles or getting lost in a good book . That’s why this list covers a little bit of everything, with prices starting at $12.98 and climbing past $400. From runners, gamers and sports fans to music lovers, readers and professional loungers, there’s plenty to explore. One thing about adults is that practical gifts are often the biggest hits, so gifting someone something they use every day but wouldn’t think to buy themselves means you’ve probably nailed it.
This Macy’s-exclusive Valentino collection features a warm, spicy fragrance with notes of violet, aromatic sage and smoked vetiver.
Labeled as an in-demand item by the retailer, the set includes a 3.4-ounce Eau de Toilette, a travel-size spray and matching shower gel, making it a well-rounded gift for fragrance enthusiasts.
For the husband who takes his beard routine seriously, this three-piece set makes a thoughtful addition to his bathroom shelf.
A popular set among users with almost 10,000 reviews on Amazon, it includes a Fortify Intense Beard Conditioner, Jelly Beard Oil and Relaxing Beard Balm. The unscented formula is made in the USA with all-natural ingredients and is cruelty-free.
Under Armour Undeniable 5.0 Medium Gym Bag
A gym bag is one of those everyday essentials that can always use an upgrade. Under Armour’s Undeniable 5.0 is lightweight, water-resistant and boasts odor-control technology. It features a vented compartment for shoes and laundry, two water bottle pockets and plenty of room for smaller essentials.
Polo Ralph Lauren Two-Tone Leather Billfold Wallet
A wallet is another everyday item that tends to stick around long after it’s ready for retirement.
This Polo Ralph Lauren billfold combines pebbled and smooth leather with the brand’s signature Pony detailing. Inside, two slip pockets and a front card slot offer practical organization, while the compact design keeps it easy to carry.

If you’re stumped on what to buy, consider gifting something he can explore throughout the year. A MasterClass membership unlocks more than 200 classes across 13 categories, covering everything from cooking and music to business. I’ve gifted this subscription to family before and found that recipients generally want it renewed yearly, making it an easy present idea every Christmas.
Ray-Ban Marvel Captain America Aviator Max Sunglasses
A little superhero nostalgia meets everyday eyewear in this special-edition pair as part of Ray-Ban’s Marvel collection .
These Aviator Max sunglasses feature Captain America’s signature shield on the metal temples, his logo on the lenses and an iconic star on the leather bridge cover. They’re also available with prescription lenses.
For the husband who rarely skips a workout, a recovery supplement can be a useful addition to his routine.
Bodi Recover delivers 20 grams of timed-release protein per scoop alongside pomegranate extract and BCAAs. We love that it comes with a vegan option and contains no soy, artificial colors, sweeteners or preservatives.
Fashion editors are seeing a shift away from the usual black and navy suits toward richer earth tones and bolder pops of color. If he’s been sticking to the classics, this burgundy suit from SuitShop is an easy way to test the waters without going too far outside his comfort zone. This two-piece set features a deep maroon shade and stretch-fit fabric, making it a stylish option for weddings, holiday parties and other occasions that call for dressing up.
Some gifts are just as entertaining to build as they are to display. This 1:8-scale Lego Technic McLaren P1 is an impressive project for adult builders, featuring a working seven-speed gearbox, V8 piston engine, suspension and butterfly-style doors. Each model also includes a unique serial number that unlocks exclusive online content.
St. Jude Holiday Skiers Stoneware Figural Mug
Apparently, people are catching on to the charm of these quirky little mugs, with Google searches for the skier design up 235 percent in 2026.
Part of the St. Jude skier mug collection , this stoneware find features quirky winter artwork that adds a little personality to any coffee break. Furthermore, 12 percent of the purchase price of select holiday items goes to St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital.
A good watch can pull together an outfit without requiring much thought. Nixon’s Sentry Stainless Steel strikes a balance between polished and casual, with a 42mm stainless steel case and matching bracelet. It also features a Japanese quartz movement, day and date displays and a 100-meter water rating. Several color options make it easier to find a favorite.
One of 2026’s most popular sneakers, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 pairs retro Y2K styling with lightweight construction and breathable materials for everyday comfort. Its layered mix of textiles, leather and plastic accents gives it a sporty look, while 12 available colorways offer plenty of styling options.
Is it even Christmas if you don’t receive a packet of underwear or socks? This Calvin Klein boxer bundle includes three pairs plus a bonus fourth, and the microfiber fabric is designed for a soft feel and comfortable movement, while the stitch-free infinity bond waistband keeps things smooth. Sometimes the simplest gifts get the most use.
Shopping for someone whose gaming preferences you can’t quite keep up with? Let him pick his next adventure.
Best Buy carries digital gift cards for platforms and brands including Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Razer and Roblox, along with Apple and Google Play. It’s a convenient option when you’d rather leave the game selection to the player.
I’ve noticed that nearly every time I’m on a plane, there’s someone working through a puzzle book, and honestly, I love seeing it. This Merriam-Webster collection makes a fun travel or couch companion, with more than 100 activities, including anagrams, word searches, mini crosswords and visual puzzles, plus 25 vocabulary and trivia quizzes.
For the sports fan who always wants to know what’s playing next, a DAZN subscription or available team package could be a welcome surprise.
Depending on location and plan, the platform offers access to boxing, soccer, NFL Game Pass internationally, basketball and other sporting events. There are also select local NBA team packages to explore, like a dedicated streaming package for the Memphis Grizzlies and the San Antonio Spurs .
Music lovers and frequent hosts will appreciate this wireless speaker’s versatility. The Denon Home 200 delivers stereo sound and supports Dolby Atmos Music, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and AirPlay 2. One feature I particularly enjoy is the ability to sync multiple Denon speakers through the HEOS app, so the same playlist can follow the party from room to room.
26-Piece Stainless Steel BBQ Tools Grilling Accessories Set
For someone who enjoys firing up the grill, this 26-piece stainless steel set covers just about every essential, from tongs and skewers to an instant-read meat thermometer and nonstick grill mats. The tools come neatly organized in a portable aluminum case, making storage and transport easy for backyard cookouts or camping trips.
For the husband who’d rather unwrap concert tickets than another pair of socks, a Ticketmaster gift card is a fun way to put a future night out on the calendar. It’s a convenient option for concerts, sporting events and live entertainment. And while Ticketmaster is an official ticketing destination for many events, it’s worth comparing prices with resale marketplaces like Vivid Seats and StubHub , which also offer gift cards and may have alternative ticket options.
A massive bestseller and now a major motion picture starring Ryan Gosling , Project Hail Mary has been a particularly popular pick among male readers this year. Andy Weir’s sci-fi thriller follows an astronaut who wakes up alone aboard a spacecraft with no memory of his mission, only to discover humanity’s survival depends on solving an impossible mystery. It’s a gripping gift for readers who love science, suspense and a clever plot.
The best Christmas gifts aren’t necessarily the biggest or most expensive. Sometimes they’re the little upgrades that make everyday life easier, while other times they’re experiences that create lasting memories. Whatever his interests may be, a thoughtful gift that reflects a little personality is always worth wrapping up.
